Airwindows by Chris Johnson: the source of every effect in the
audioairwindows module.

Source: https://github.com/airwindows/airwindows
Commit: b110fac3991fff7c4655cc2d25d6a3e221f9799c
License: MIT, see LICENSE (Copyright (c) 2018 Chris Johnson)

tools/awgen translates, for each plug-in under
plugins/LinuxVST/src/<Name>/, the float processReplacing loop of
<Name>Proc.cpp and the constructor, parameter defaults and setParameter of
<Name>.cpp into src/airwindows/plugins/<Name>.c. tools/awgen/plugins.json
lists every plug-in, with upstream's one-line summary and its collections
(Basic, Recommended, Latest) from upstream's plug-in list.

What the translation changes:

  - int16 in and out, with no dither on the way out;
  - fixed seeds in place of rand() for the noise and dither generators, so
    a node renders the same take twice (the reference tests give upstream
    the same seeds);
  - a second, single-precision variant of each loop for parts whose FPU
    has no double or divide, with a polynomial sine in place of libm's.
    tools/awgen/policy.json names the plug-ins whose single-precision loop
    is outside the accuracy bar; their fast variant runs the reference
    arithmetic instead.

Plug-ins the generator does not carry are listed with the reason in
docs/reference/plugins.md.
